company_name: 莱克电气股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-outcome underwriting of the consolidated enterprise at the 2018-12-31 information cutoff.
underwriting_route: Underwrite established appliance and ODM earning power; condition cash accessibility and exclude unproven growth returns.

situation_model.summary: The company combines domestic brands and channels with international ODM manufacturing across cleaning appliances and garden tools.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Competitive appliance markets with raw-material, foreign-exchange and channel pressure; premium product and brand execution can offset but not remove these forces.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit pools favor differentiated products, brands and efficient ODM supply; input inflation, customer concentration and bargaining power transmit downside to margins and working capital.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: Exposure spans LEXY, Bewinch and Jimmy domestic brands, online/offline channels and overseas ODM customers; top-five customers were 39.81% of FY2017 revenue with names undisclosed.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: Product high-endization, own-brand expansion and mixed channel development are observable adaptations, while segment-level economics remain undisclosed.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Reported adjusted net profit was RMB345.8m, RMB465.8m and RMB341.0m in FY2015-2017; FY2017 revenue grew while profit and operating cash fell, indicating mixed normalization.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Slow value loss is possible through sustained margin/input pressure, working-capital absorption or low-return retention even though cash balances and solvency appear resilient.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a current-earnings route; treat accessible cash and growth capital separately and conditionally, without price or return claims.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: The strongest rival is a differentiated branded-appliance competitor that converts product innovation and channel reach into higher, more stable owner cash than this mixed brand/ODM model.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff reports show sustained revenue growth with restored margins and operating cash despite input-cost and foreign-exchange pressure.
Entity-level disclosures and distributions establish that consolidated cash is materially accessible to ordinary shareholders.
Matched growth-capital cohorts disclose adequate incremental earnings and cash after working-capital and integration absorption.

business_position: Established technology and manufacturing platform with three domestic brands and broad ODM customer reach, but customer identities and segment profitability are not disclosed.
survival_case: FY2017 cash and equivalents were RMB1.95bn; borrowings included RMB300m due within one year, while no restricted cash was reported. Rising working capital and lower operating cash require monitoring but do not by themselves indicate insolvency.
adaptation_case: Management expanded own-brand, premium-product and online/offline channel efforts while retaining overseas ODM; evidence supports adaptation activity, not yet its incremental return.
normalization_case: Use FY2015-2017 adjusted net profit as a volatile reference range. FY2017 raw-material, FX and compensation/payment pressures reduced profit and operating cash, so normalized earnings are mixed rather than a point estimate.
permanent_loss_map: Permanent-loss paths are margin erosion from inputs/FX, cash absorption in receivables and inventory, and retention of capital without proven incremental returns; cash accessibility and growth returns remain conditional.

value_route.route_reasoning: Current earning power is the only route directly supported across three years. Growth and full cash realization require evidence not supplied at cutoff and therefore remain conditional or excluded.

strongest_rival: The strongest rival is a differentiated branded-appliance competitor that converts product innovation and channel reach into higher, more stable owner cash than this mixed brand/ODM model.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff reports show sustained revenue growth with restored margins and operating cash despite input-cost and foreign-exchange pressure.
Entity-level disclosures and distributions establish that consolidated cash is materially accessible to ordinary shareholders.
Matched growth-capital cohorts disclose adequate incremental earnings and cash after working-capital and integration absorption.

component_treatments.reason: Three years of adjusted net profit and operating cash provide a direct mature-earnings base despite volatility.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the base earnings route; no precision beyond a bounded historical range.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote confidence if post-cutoff margins and operating cash stabilize across reported years.

component_treatments.reason: Cash is material and unrestricted cash was reported, but entity-level accessibility and distribution are not mapped.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Use only a conditional owner-cash range; do not count consolidated cash as fully accessible.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve with ownership, restrictions, taxes and ordinary-shareholder distribution evidence.

component_treatments.reason: Brand, channel and overseas expansion are described, but matched incremental returns and absorption are not disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Exclude growth premium from base route and treat retention as a permanent-loss risk until returns are demonstrated.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only after cohort-level capital, earnings and cash conversion close on the same responsibility unit.

component_treatments.reason: Working-capital growth, long-lived-asset spending and changing bank borrowings directly affect financing pressure.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Maintain a financing-pressure overlay; FY2017 lower operating cash and RMB300m current debt maturity constrain flexibility.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Reduce pressure if cash conversion and debt schedule improve without renewed borrowing dependence.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Sustained margins and operating cash across subsequent annual reports.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Persistent earnings and cash deterioration that cannot be explained by temporary input or FX effects.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Disclosures reconcile subsidiary ownership, restrictions and distributions to ordinary shareholders.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Material restrictions, non-controlling claims or persistent non-distribution make cash inaccessible.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Matched cohort evidence shows incremental earnings and cash after all capital and working-capital absorption.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Growth spending continues without responsibility-matched returns or owner realization.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Debt maturities are funded from recurring operating cash without renewed leverage.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Refinancing dependence or cash shortfall impairs continuity.

rows.economic_reason: Observed adjusted net profit range across FY2015-FY2017 is the mature-earnings reference.

quantification.reason: Cash accessibility and distribution are not disclosed by entity.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Do not add a point estimate; keep owner-cash effect conditional.

rows.economic_reason: Consolidated cash may support owners but realization is unresolved.

quantification.reason: Incremental returns on brand and channel investment are not disclosed.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Exclude growth uplift from base earnings.

rows.economic_reason: Expansion activity lacks matched return evidence.

normal_earnings.basis: Segment margin and pass-through are undisclosed.

owner_cash.basis: Cash conversion by segment is undisclosed.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated appliance operations; product and customer pass-through not separately disclosed.

range.basis: Receivables and inventory rose through FY2017; magnitude unresolved.

normal_earnings.basis: Working-capital effects on normalized earnings are not isolated.

owner_cash.basis: Receivables, inventory and payables changes are disclosed only in aggregate.

delta.conservative_treatment: Do not assign a numeric owner-cash delta.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated working capital and ordinary-shareholder cash realization.

evidence_trace.scope: Adjusted profit, revenue and operating cash across FY2015-2017
Cash balances, restricted-cash disclosures and subsidiary perimeter
Brands, channels, ODM model and new subsidiaries
Receivables, inventory, payables, long-lived-asset spending and borrowings

underwriting_thesis.central_path: A diversified appliance platform can sustain a bounded mature-earnings base, but owner cash and growth value depend on unresolved accessibility and incremental-return evidence.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: BASE_RANGE for established earnings using FY2015-2017 adjusted profit; FY2017 deterioration keeps the range conservative.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: CONDITIONAL_RANGE because consolidated cash is sizeable yet entity-level realization is unproven.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Base paths include margin erosion and working-capital absorption; low-return growth retention is conditional until matched returns are shown.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is current earning power; unproven growth is excluded from base and no price or return is stated.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: The strongest rival is a differentiated branded-appliance competitor that converts product innovation and channel reach into higher, more stable owner cash than this mixed brand/ODM model.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Monitor post-cutoff annual reports for margin and operating-cash recovery, entity-level cash distributions, debt maturity funding and matched returns on brand/channel capital.

investment_treatment: Underwrite the established operating platform conditionally on cash realization and financing discipline; keep growth value unresolved and require reversal evidence before promotion.
